title: Present
statementMd:
Little beaver is a beginner programmer, so informatics is his favorite subject. Soon his informatics teacher is going to have a birthday and the beaver has decided to prepare a present for her. He planted $*n*$ flowers in a row on his windowsill and started waiting for them to grow. However, after some time the beaver noticed that the flowers stopped growing. The beaver thinks it is bad manners to present little flowers. So he decided to come up with some solutions.

There are $*m*$ days left to the birthday. The height of the $*i*$-th flower (assume that the flowers in the row are numbered from $1$ to $*n*$ from left to right) is equal to $*a*_{*i*}$ at the moment. At each of the remaining $*m*$ days the beaver can take a special watering and water $*w*$ contiguous flowers (he can do that only once at a day). At that each watered flower grows by one height unit on that day. The beaver wants the height of the smallest flower be as large as possible in the end. What maximum height of the smallest flower can he get?

## Input

The first line contains space-separated integers $*n*$, $*m*$ and $*w*$ $(1 ≤ *w* ≤ *n* ≤ 10^{5}; 1 ≤ *m* ≤ 10^{5})$. The second line contains space-separated integers $*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, ..., *a*_{*n*}$ $(1 ≤ *a*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{9})$.

## Output

Print a single integer — the maximum final height of the smallest flower.

## Note

In the first sample beaver can water the last 3 flowers at the first day. On the next day he may not to water flowers at all. In the end he will get the following heights: [2, 2, 2, 3, 2, 2]. The smallest flower has height equal to 2. It's impossible to get height 3 in this test.
statementZhMd:
小海狸是一名初级程序员，因此信息学是他最喜欢的科目。不久之后，他的信息学老师就要过生日了，于是小海狸决定为她准备一份礼物。他在窗台上种了一排 $*n*$ 朵花，然后开始等待它们成长。然而，过了一段时间，小海狸发现花停止生长了。小海狸认为送小花是不礼貌的，所以他决定想办法解决这个问题。

距离老师的生日还有 $*m*$ 天。此时第 $*i*$ 朵花的高度（假设这一排花从左到右编号为 $1$ 到 $*n*$）等于 $*a*_{*i*}$。在剩下的 $*m*$ 天中的每一天，小海狸都可以使用特殊的浇水器给连续的 $*w*$ 朵花浇水（每天最多进行一次）。每朵被浇水的花在当天都会长高一个单位。小海狸希望最终最矮的花尽可能高。最终他能使最矮的花达到的最大高度是多少？

## 输入格式

第一行包含空格分隔的整数 $*n*$、$*m*$ 和 $*w*$（$1 ≤ *w* ≤ *n* ≤ 10^{5}; 1 ≤ *m* ≤ 10^{5}$）。第二行包含空格分隔的整数 $*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, ..., *a*_{*n*}$（$1 ≤ *a*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{9}$）。

## 输出格式

输出一个整数，即最终最矮花朵的最大高度。

## 说明

在第一个样例中，小海狸可以在第一天给最后 3 朵花浇水。第二天他可以不浇水。最终花朵的高度为：[2, 2, 2, 3, 2, 2]。最矮花朵的高度为 2。在这个测试中，不可能使最矮花朵的高度达到 3。
